text_en: Do not envy the wicked, nor desire to be with them;
text_cn: 你不要妒忌作恶的人，不要希求与他们共处；

text_en: for their minds devise violence, and their lips talk of mischief.
text_cn: 因为他们的心灵，只图谋不轨；他们的嘴唇，只讲论是非。

text_en: By wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established;
text_cn: 因着智慧，家庭得以兴建；因着明智，家庭得以稳定。

text_en: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
text_cn: 各种珍奇可爱的宝物，因着智识可储藏满室。

text_en: Wise warriors are mightier than strong ones, and those who have knowledge than those who have strength;
text_cn: 智慧人胜于壮士，明智人强于勇士；

text_en: for by wise guidance you can wage your war, and in abundance of counselors there is victory.
text_cn: 因为作战须有智谋，胜利在于谋士众多。

text_en: Wisdom is too high for fools; in the gate they do not open their mouths.
text_cn: 为愚昧的人，智慧太高妙；他在城门口，只好不开口。

text_en: Whoever plans to do evil will be called a mischief-maker.
text_cn: 筹划作恶的人，可称为阴险家。

text_en: The devising of folly is sin, and the scoffer is an abomination to all.
text_cn: 愚人的计谋只是罪恶；狂妄的人为人所憎恶。

text_en: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength being small;
text_cn: 你若萎靡不振，到灾难的日子，必然气竭力尽。

text_en: if you hold back from rescuing those taken away to death, those who go staggering to the slaughter;
text_cn: 被带去受死的人，你应拯救他；行将被杀戮的人，你要挽救他。

text_en: if you say, “Look, we did not know this”— does not he who weighs the heart perceive it? Does not he who keeps watch over your soul know it? And will he not repay all according to their deeds?
text_cn: 或许你要说：“看！我全不知道！”难道那权衡人心的能不明了？难道监察你心灵的能不知道？他必按每人的作为还报每人。

text_en: My child, eat honey, for it is good, and the drippings of the honeycomb are sweet to your taste.
text_cn: 我儿，你要吃蜜，因为蜜好；蜂房的蜜，香甜可口。

text_en: Know that wisdom is such to your soul; if you find it, you will find a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
text_cn: 对你的灵魂，智慧也是这样：你找得了她，必有好前途；你所希望的，决不会落空。

text_en: Do not lie in wait like an outlaw against the home of the righteous; do no violence to the place where the righteous live;
text_cn: 恶人，对义人的家，不要图谋不轨；对他的住所，不要加以破坏；

text_en: for though they fall seven times, they will rise again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
text_cn: 因为义人虽七次跌倒，仍然要起来；但是恶人一失足，必陷祸患中。

text_en: Do not rejoice when your enemies fall, and do not let your heart be glad when they stumble,
text_cn: 你的仇人跌倒，且不要高兴；他若失足摔倒，且不要心喜；

text_en: or else the Lord will see it and be displeased, and turn away his anger from them.
text_cn: 免得上主看见而不快，因而撤消对他的忿怒。

text_en: Do not fret because of evildoers. Do not envy the wicked;
text_cn: 对作恶的人，你不要动怒；对乖戾之徒，也不必嫉妒；

text_en: for the evil have no future; the lamp of the wicked will go out.
text_cn: 因为恶人终没有好前途，恶人的灯必要熄灭。

text_en: My child, fear the Lord and the king, and do not disobey either of them;
text_cn: 我儿，上主和君王，你都要敬畏；对他们二者，皆不可触怒；

text_en: for disaster comes from them suddenly, and who knows the ruin that both can bring?
text_cn: 因为他们的惩罚可突然而至；他们的摧残，有谁能知晓？

text_en: These also are sayings of the wise: Partiality in judging is not good.
text_cn: 以下是智者的箴言：在判案时，顾及情面，决不公平。

text_en: Whoever says to the wicked, “You are innocent, ” will be cursed by peoples, abhorred by nations;
text_cn: 谁对恶人说：“你是正义的。”人民必骂他，百姓必恨他。

text_en: but those who rebuke the wicked will have delight, and a good blessing will come upon them.
text_cn: 按公道加罚的，必事事顺遂；美好的祝福，必临于其身。

text_en: One who gives an honest answer gives a kiss on the lips.
text_cn: 应答适宜的人，宛如与人接吻。

text_en: Prepare your work outside, get everything ready for you in the field; and after that build your house.
text_cn: 你要先在外经营好事业，在田间将工作准备停当，然后才可建立你的家室。

text_en: Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.
text_cn: 不要轻易作证，反对你的近人；也不要以你的口舌，欺骗他人。

text_en: Do not say, “I will do to others as they have done to me; I will pay them back for what they have done. ”
text_cn: 不可说：“人怎样待我，我怎样待人；照人之所行，我向他还报。”

text_en: I passed by the field of one who was lazy, by the vineyard of a stupid person;
text_cn: 我走过懒惰人的田地，经过愚昧人的葡萄园：

text_en: and see, it was all overgrown with thorns; the ground was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.
text_cn: 看，到处是荆棘，满地是蒺(jí)藜(lí)，石墙也倒了！

text_en: Then I saw and considered it; I looked and received instruction.
text_cn: 我看了，便心下自思；我见了，取得了教训：

text_en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
text_cn: “再睡片刻，再假寐片刻，再抱臂躺卧片刻”——

text_en: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and want, like an armed warrior.
text_cn: 这样，贫穷就要如同窃贼，困乏也要如同武士，向你侵袭。
